trust_decision.summary: A component instance decides which request's controller/helpers/request/view context/lookup context/format it renders with; at the pinned commit Base#render_in and its accessors memoize these with ||= on first render, so any later render of the same instance (or a Collection's cached child instances) trusts stale state from an earlier request.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'reused component instances retain stale render context'; Base#render_in is the documented render entrypoint and holds the ||= memoized view_context/lookup_context/view_flow/requested_details.

fix_sites.entry_point: ViewComponent::Base#controller (public accessor, reset via new __vc_reset_render_state! fix.diff:87-95)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Collection builds a distinct new instance per item, so caching @components looks like a harmless perf memo and 'each item is a different instance', not a reused one; the spacer is caller-owned.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Slot state set before render via with_*/with_content must survive render_in (fix deliberately preserves @__vc_set_slots/@__vc_content_set_by_with_content); a Collection with a spacer instance must be renderable repeatedly (fix dups the spacer); helpers must keep reusing the original view context so helper ivars persist across components/partials. An over-broad reset (clearing all ivars, rebuilding helpers via controller.view_context, or raising on any second render_in of the spacer) breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: same instance aliased twice in one render (array of items) test/sandbox/test/rendering_test.rb:1077-1081
same Collection object rendered twice (cached child instances) lib/view_component/collection.rb:37
shared spacer_component instance across items/renders lib/view_component/collection.rb:75
guard enabled (raise) vs disabled (warn + state refresh) fix.diff:66-79

O7_producer.where: lib/view_component/collection.rb:37-47 (Collection#components memo produces the instances that get re-rendered); lib/view_component/slot.rb:46,54 (Slot#to_s memoizes rendered @content)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Slot#to_s memoizes rendered slot HTML in @content; with the guard disabled (warn mode, where the fix promises state is refreshed) a reused parent re-emits slot output rendered under the earlier request.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Fix comment says slot state is caller-populated before render_in and is intentionally preserved; warn mode is a 'one-release migration' legacy path.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: separate file (slot.rb), same package; reached via slotable.rb

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Slots set from inside the render block (content evaluation during render) are pushed into @__vc_set_slots each render; in warn mode collection slots accumulate entries (with cached output) from previous renders.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Indistinguishable at a glance from legitimate pre-render with_* slot state the fix explicitly keeps; neighbouring slots feature.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a per-instance memo of the i18n locale or @view_context-derived translator (e.g. @__vc_locale ||= ::I18n.locale) that survives reuse
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: translate is called many times per render and already reads @view_context; memoizing locale/scope per instance is a natural perf tweak.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: memoized request format / annotate decision (@__vc_html_request ||= request&.format == :html)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Computed every render from request; a maintainer could cache it next to the other ||= ivars.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a prepended render_in wrapper that caches payload/view identifier per instance instead of resetting it in ensure
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Second implementation of render_in via prepend; a plausible variant skips the ensure reset.

O9_family: stale per-request state on reused objects (cross-request information exposure; CWE-488/CWE-668)

O10_build.toolchain: Bundler + Rails sandbox app under test/sandbox, minitest (rake test)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Replace the ||= in Base#render_in with = and stop, leaving controller/helpers/request memos, Collection's cached @components and the shared spacer untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: docs/guide/getting-started.md:107-119 documents render_in for 'reuse' in controllers (fresh instance each time, not the flaw, but a wording that may mislead solvers).
